servers.notes: 27 tools, one per FMP API docs category (each groups many REST endpoints, e.g. statements covers all statement, ratio and metric endpoints); names read from the official FMP connector page in the Anthropic Claude connector directory, which lists all 27; FMP own docs name only quote. tools/list needs an API key (anonymous call returns 401). Descriptions paraphrase the matching FMP docs category. Calls count against the FMP plan limits; endpoint coverage depends on plan. Marked incomplete because the list comes only from the Claude connector directory snapshot, which lagged the live servers in cross-checks (it missed newer tools for Aiera, Daloopa, S&P Global, Alpha Vantage, CoinGecko and Blockscout); the live tools/list needs sign-in (anonymous call returns 401/403).

servers.notes: Tool names are the Python function names upper-cased (e.g. TIME_SERIES_DAILY). The full flat catalog is exposed plus three legacy meta-tools (TOOL_LIST, TOOL_GET, TOOL_CALL). PING and ADD_TWO_NUMBERS are test tools that ship in the catalog. SEARCH/FETCH (openai.py) are deliberately not exposed. Free key has a low daily call limit; premium plans unlock realtime/higher limits and some endpoints. ~225 GitHub stars. The Anthropic Claude connector directory lists 126 of these names (it lacks COMPANY_LOGO, CONGRESS_TRADES, POLITICIAN_METADATA, REALTIME_BULK_BID_ASK_PRICES, TOOL_CALL, TOOL_GET, TOOL_LIST).

servers.notes: Repo moved from polygon-io/mcp_polygon (redirects). Instead of one tool per endpoint, three composable tools cover the whole REST API: endpoints are indexed at start-up from massive.com/docs/rest/llms.txt (stocks, options, forex, crypto, futures aggregates, trades/quotes, snapshots, gainers/losers, reference data, fundamentals, news, economy). Results can be stored as in-memory SQLite tables and post-processed with built-in functions: bs_price, bs_delta, bs_gamma, bs_theta, bs_vega, bs_rho, bs_vanna, bs_volga, bs_charm, bs_veta, bs_color, simple_return, log_return, cumulative_return, sharpe_ratio, sortino_ratio, sma, ema. Capability coverage is far wider than the 3 tool names suggest. ~400 GitHub stars.

servers.notes: Official tastytrade server (~37 stars). 84 tools (cross-checked against the 84 names in tool-metadata.ts); tastytrade_get_orders is a deprecated alias of tastytrade_search_orders. TASTYTRADE_READ_ONLY hides all write/destructive tools. Live orders are gated behind dry-run and confirmation tokens. Covers accounts, balances, positions, orders (incl. complex/OTOCO via dry-run), equity/futures/futures-option/crypto/warrant instruments, option chains, market metrics (IV rank), sessions/holidays, margin/SPAN, risk-free rate, quote alerts, watchlists, DXLink streaming handoff. The popular community alternative is ferdousbhai/tasty-agent (~89 stars).

servers.notes: ~5,202 stars; second most-starred TradingView MCP. Uses TradingView screener/TA data (no TradingView account), Yahoo Finance and licensed Marketaux news. 39 tools (README says 39; source has 39 @mcp.tool handlers): gainers/losers, Bollinger and candle/volume scanners, multi-timeframe TA, multi-agent debate, Egyptian Exchange (EGX) tools, smart-money proxy, news sentiment, backtests incl. walk-forward, options chain and unusual activity, futures snapshots, extended hours, stock screener. servers.notes: 48 tools from the official docs page: projects, files (create/edit with compile), compile, backtests (create/read/orders/logs), parameter optimizations, live deployment (create, holdings, logs, stop, liquidate), Jupyter research notebooks, object store, dataset catalog, library support, skills, and email/SMS/Telegram notifications. The GitHub repo now holds only a README pointing to the hosted server. ~80 stars; community alternative taylorwilsdon/quantconnect-mcp ~125 stars. Access needs a paid organization tier plus a paid agent node (A1-1, A4-8 or A16-32); the free A-MICRO node cannot connect. Node prices are on the QuantConnect pricing page (not read).

servers.notes: ~240 stars, very active. 71 [McpServerTool] tools across modules: CBOE put/call and VIX, CFTC COT, Congress trades and net worth, FDA advisory meetings, FINRA short volume/interest, off-exchange volume and squeeze scores, FRED and Canadian macro with release calendar, federal contracts, 13F holdings analytics (holder mix, flows, clone backtests, consensus), Schedules 13D/G, Forms 4/5/144, XBRL facts, statements and revenue breakdowns, SEC filing and transcript RAG search, FTDs, Form D, N-PORT/N-CEN funds, Form ADV advisers, Yahoo prices/dividends and a few technical indicators. Equibles Cloud runs the same core with the same tool names and adds more tools (transcripts and audio, real-time quotes, options chains with Greeks, KPIs and guidance, buybacks, IPO filings, executive changes, valuation multiples, index composition, portfolio tracking, screener); Equibles Cloud advertises 130 tools in total (per daniel3303/stock-market-mcp-server), but its full list is not published, so only the 71 open-source tools are listed.

tools.description: Expected edge half-life under a crowding decay model: ln2 / (theta + delta_max * adoption^curvature), in periods of the caller's IC series.

servers.notes: Not a data server: exposes the luck-robust benchmark scoring kernel for trading agents (deflated Sharpe, pass^k, process discipline, anti-gaming audits, regime comparison, uncertainty decomposition, crowding half-life, Black-Scholes Greeks). 14 tools. ~7 stars. servers.notes: Official OKX server (~501 stars). 179 tools across modules: market data and indicators/filters, spot, perpetual swap, delivery futures, options (incl. Greeks), algo orders, account, event contracts, news and sentiment with economic calendar, trading bots (grid, DCA, smart portfolio), earn products, smart-money trader signals, audit, skills. Default modules are spot, swap, option, account, bot.grid, skills; --modules all enables the rest (market, futures, bot.dca, earn.*, smartmoney, news, event). 22 swap/futures order tools are generated from a shared template (names composed in source).

servers.notes: Official Kraken server (~797 stars, cli v0.5.1). 152 MCP tools (the catalog has 188 commands; 31 streaming, 3 interactive and 2 withheld are not tools): spot market data, account, trading, funding, earn, subaccounts, futures, paper trading for spot and futures with live prices, workspace and PnL explanation. Default services (market, account, paper, workspace, feedback) serve a subset; -s all serves all 152 (count matches README). Dangerous tools (real orders, withdrawals) need acknowledged=true and are marked [dangerous]; [auth] marks tools needing API credentials.

servers.notes: Official Bybit server (~43 stars, pushed 2026-10-30). 376 registered tools generated from the Bybit V5 API (README says 382; 22 more generated files for convert/deposit/withdraw queries are not imported by any index). Covers market data, trading, positions, spot margin, account, assets, earn products, crypto loans, RFQ and spread trading, copy trading, bots/strategies, P2P, fiat convert, broker/affiliate/referral, tax, Alpha, launchpool, WebSocket trading and subscriptions. Descriptions are the first line of each generated tool description (subscription tool descriptions translated from Chinese).

servers.name: Gate MCP - info (market intelligence)
servers.setup: Remote URL https://api.gatemcp.ai/mcp/info (no authentication)

tools.name: info_coin_get_coin_info
tools.description: Look up one cryptocurrency profile by ticker, name, contract address, or Gate symbol. Optional chain disambiguates address clashes. Returns matching rows with basic project fields. Read-only public data.

tools.name: info_coin_get_coin_rankings
tools.description: Boards: popular, gainers/losers, twitter_hot, airdrop, new_listing, market_pulse_hot. time_range only for gainers/losers. Single match→get_coin_info. Filtered list→search_coins. Read-only public research data.

tools.name: info_coin_search_coins
tools.description: Multi-row asset list by category, chain, cap, type. One clear match→get_coin_info. Boards→get_coin_rankings. Read-only public research data. No account access, no order placement or fund transfers. Not investment advice.

tools.name: info_compliance_check_token_security
tools.description: Public heuristic token security screen (e.g. tax/holder-risk style signals from data providers). Not a security guarantee or legal/investment advice. On-chain activity stats→get_token_onchain.

tools.name: info_macro_get_economic_calendar
tools.description: Filtered release calendar in a date window. Zero-arg dashboard→get_macro_summary. Indicator snapshot or series→get_macro_indicator. Read-only public research data. No account access, no order placement or fund transfers.

tools.name: info_macro_get_macro_indicator
tools.description: Official macro stats: latest or series by country/indicator (CPI, rates, jobs). No event feed. Calendar→get_economic_calendar. Dashboard→get_macro_summary. Read-only public research data. No account access.

tools.name: info_macro_get_macro_summary
tools.description: Zero-arg macro dashboard: key snapshots plus upcoming releases. Filtered calendar list→get_economic_calendar. Indicator snapshot or series→get_macro_indicator. Read-only public research data. No account access.

tools.name: info_marketdetail_get_kline
tools.description: Read-only Gate candlesticks for a trading pair or contract. Inputs: symbol (required), timeframe (validated per market_type; delivery excludes 1s|3d), market_type spot|futures|delivery|options (default spot)

tools.name: info_marketdetail_get_orderbook
tools.description: Read-only Gate order book depth (bids/asks as price/size) for a trading pair or contract. Inputs: symbol (required), market_type spot|futures|delivery|options (default spot), depth 1–100 (default 20; over-limit rejected)

tools.name: info_marketdetail_get_recent_trades
tools.description: Read-only recent Gate trade prints for a trading pair or contract. Inputs: symbol (required), market_type spot|futures|delivery|options (default spot), limit 1–400 (default 50; over-limit rejected)

tools.name: info_marketsnapshot_batch_market_snapshot
tools.description: Batch market snapshots for up to 20 symbols; raw array length 1–20 before trim/dedupe; missing symbols appear in not_found. Same timeframe/source/quote/scope semantics as the single-symbol snapshot.

tools.name: info_marketsnapshot_get_institutional_metrics
tools.description: BTC/ETH institutional ETF/CME/CFTC daily metrics (OpenSearch). asset=BTC|ETH|all; channel=all|etf|cme|cftc nulls non-selected fields. CME often null with data_status cme_source_not_procured.

tools.name: info_marketsnapshot_get_market_overview
tools.description: Broad market overview dashboard: capitalization, volume, dominance, and sentiment style metrics. No symbol required. Read-only public market breadth data. Read-only public research data. No account access.

tools.name: info_marketsnapshot_get_market_snapshot
tools.description: One-symbol market snapshot: realtime price, a short kline clip, and project summary. Inputs include symbol, timeframe, source (e.g. spot), quote, and scope. When no data exists for the symbol.

tools.name: info_markettrend_get_indicator_history
tools.description: Historical indicator columns (RSI, MACD, MAs). OHLCV→get_kline. Chart-label snapshot→get_technical_analysis. Not trading signals or investment recommendations. Read-only public research data. No account access.

tools.name: info_markettrend_get_kline
tools.description: Trend-index OHLCV for symbols, with optional indicator bundle. Exchange pair or contract candles, or fine intervals→marketdetail_get_kline. Columns→get_indicator_history. Chart-label snapshot→get_technical_analysis.

tools.name: info_markettrend_get_technical_analysis
tools.description: Multi-timeframe chart-derived labels (e.g. bullish/bearish/neutral style summaries) from OHLCV only—descriptive research, not a price forecast or investment recommendation. OHLCV→get_kline.

tools.name: info_onchain_get_address_info
tools.description: Wallet profile: asset_summary, token_balances (USD desc), multi_chain_token_balances, labels/risk; Solana adds token_account/mint_account. Chain aliases: op→optimism, avax|avalanche-c→avalanche, bera|berachain→bera.

tools.name: info_onchain_get_address_transactions
tools.description: Paginated transfers; BTC items include inputs/outputs/tx_status. partial_upstream_response when upstream total>0 but list unparseable. Chain aliases same as get_address_info. Profile→get_address_info.

tools.name: info_onchain_get_token_onchain
tools.description: Token scope: holders, transfers, activity, smart_money. Address ledger→get_address_transactions. One tx→get_transaction. Read-only public research data. No account access, no order placement or fund transfers.

tools.name: info_onchain_get_transaction
tools.description: One transaction by hash; fields sparse if upstream thin. Token view→get_token_onchain. Read-only public research data. No account access, no order placement or fund transfers. Not investment advice.

tools.name: info_platformmetrics_get_bridge_metrics
tools.description: Bridge ranking or one-bridge chain breakdown. Cross-sector dashboard across DeFi, spot, perp, stablecoin, or bridge→get_defi_overview. Read-only public research data. No account access.

tools.name: info_platformmetrics_get_cex_orderbook_depth
tools.description: Competitor CEX ±1% order-book depth (spot/perp) from warehouse indices; BTC/ETH liquidity benchmarking. Gate native ladder→get_orderbook. Read-only public research data. No account access.

tools.name: info_platformmetrics_get_chain_activity
tools.description: Chain-level activity metrics by metric_group. staking: Ethereum daily staking_metrics.series. l2: L2 ops daily l2_metrics.series.

tools.name: info_platformmetrics_get_defi_overview
tools.description: Cross-sector dashboard for DeFi, spot, perp, stablecoin, or bridge categories. One bridge ranking or chain detail→get_bridge_metrics. One protocol→get_platform_info. Read-only public research data. No account access.

tools.name: info_platformmetrics_get_exchange_reserves
tools.description: Exchange reserve snapshots by venue and asset. scope=full adds por (PoR attestation). scope=full + include_flows=true returns flows.series[] (daily inflow/outflow/netflow)

tools.name: info_platformmetrics_get_liquidation_heatmap
tools.description: Liquidation density by symbol and price buckets. Read-only public research data. No account access, no order placement or fund transfers. Not investment advice.

tools.name: info_platformmetrics_get_platform_history
tools.description: Daily TVL, volume, and fees time series for one named protocol. One-shot profile→get_platform_info. Ranked multi-protocol list→search_platforms. CEX perps history: pass exchange_slug (e.g. gate) or platform_name.

tools.name: info_platformmetrics_get_platform_info
tools.description: One-shot protocol profile by name and scope. scope=full adds competition_metrics{} for CEX venues (spot/derivs/depth/OI core+extended/PoR). Set include_oi_symbol_detail=true with oi_symbol_limit.

tools.name: info_platformmetrics_get_stablecoin_info
tools.description: Stablecoin-only ranking or per-symbol chain breakdown. scope=full with sections=issuance_flow returns issuance_flows[] (CryptoQuant net issuance/redemption); sections=usage_structure returns real usage metrics.

tools.name: info_platformmetrics_get_yield_pools
tools.description: Lending and LP pools by APY or TVL. scope=full adds apy_base_30d, apy_reward_30d, reward_tokens, market_share. One protocol profile→get_platform_info. TVL series→get_platform_history. Read-only public research data.

tools.name: info_platformmetrics_search_platforms
tools.description: Ranked multi-protocol list with filter and sort. One-shot profile→get_platform_info. One named protocol daily series→get_platform_history. Read-only public research data. No account access.

servers.notes: 32 tools (live list): coin discovery, market snapshots and details, trends, technical analysis, platform metrics, on-chain data, macro indicators, compliance checks.

servers.name: Gate MCP - news
servers.setup: Remote URL https://api.gatemcp.ai/mcp/news (no authentication)

tools.name: news_events_explain_market_move
tools.description: [Read] Explain what drove a crypto asset's price move in a given time window. Returns a concise summary (from real-time Tavily search), the latest high-priority real-time events.

tools.name: news_events_get_event_detail
tools.description: [Read] Full detail for one event_id only, including persisted impact_direction and impact_direction_reason. Filtered event list or timeline -> get_latest_events. Unknown id returns not found.

tools.name: news_events_get_latest_events
tools.description: [Read] Filtered event list or timeline; each row includes event_id and persisted impact_direction/impact_direction_reason. Optional direction filter. One event_id detail -> get_event_detail.

tools.name: news_events_get_market_move_report
tools.description: [Read] Query a stored market-move attribution report by symbol, optional report_id, or optional event_id. Lookup priority is report_id > event_id > latest report for symbol.

tools.name: news_events_list_market_move_reports
tools.description: [Read] List stored market-move attribution reports for one symbol, filtering by an inclusive UTC0 updated_at range and sorting results by event_time descending. Reports may be updated after their market event.

tools.name: news_feed_get_exchange_announcements
tools.description: [Read] Venue-published exchange notices: listings, delistings, maintenance. Media rumors or general crypto headlines -> search_news. Read-only public research data. No account access.

tools.name: news_feed_get_hot_topics
tools.description: [Read] Get the top 2-4 social discussion themes for one coin over the latest 4h, including direction, influence, sentiment, platforms, and representative evidence posts. For arbitrary social search use search_ugc.

tools.name: news_feed_get_mention_burst
tools.description: [Read] Get a coin's 24h multi-platform social mention burst signal, growth, sentiment direction, platform breakdown, and display eligibility. For general sentiment ratios and sample tweets use get_social_sentiment.

tools.name: news_feed_get_social_sentiment
tools.description: [Read] Aggregate per-coin social sentiment for a time range: overall sentiment, positive/negative split, mention count, and sample tweets. X/Twitter post search or tweet-level evidence -> search_x.

tools.name: news_feed_search_news
tools.description: [Read] Search the platform news index for headlines, news items, and briefing-style result lists. Open-web research with synthesized answers and cited external pages -> web_search.

tools.name: news_feed_search_ugc
tools.description: [Read] Reddit/Discord/Telegram/YouTube-style UGC: non-empty query uses vector API; coin without query uses OpenSearch. Both empty invalid. X/Twitter narrative -> search_x; headlines -> search_news.

tools.name: news_feed_search_x
tools.description: [Read] Search and analyze X/Twitter discussions for a topic, with tweet-level evidence and cited posts. Aggregate social mood, sentiment score, or positive/negative split -> get_social_sentiment.

tools.name: news_feed_web_search
tools.description: [Read] Search the open web and return a synthesized answer with cited external pages. Built-in headline lookup, news-item search, or briefing-style news list -> search_news.

tools.name: news_prediction_get_event_signal
tools.description: [Read] Single event signal from dws_external_event_signal_hf by event_ref (venue:venue_event_id). window 1h/24h/7d (default 24h). Returns outcome_probabilities, volume_flow, directional_context.

tools.name: news_prediction_get_fastest_rising_ranking
tools.description: [Read] Daily venue/overall ranking by probability rise (UTC rank_date). Optional venue[], category, status (same as volume_delta ranking). Drops rows missing open_mid_probability_utc or probability_delta_today.

tools.name: news_prediction_get_market_orderbook
tools.description: [Read] Live current order book only (mode=current). depth 1-20 (default 20). polymarket: market_id=venue_market_id; needs opensearch.predictionMarketIndex for token lookup (else not_implemented)

tools.name: news_prediction_get_volume_delta_ranking
tools.description: [Read] Daily venue/overall ranking by volume delta (UTC rank_date). Optional venue[], category (exact term on rank index), status (active/closed/resolved/all; default active). Requires opensearch.predictionRankIndex.

tools.name: news_prediction_search_events
tools.description: [Read] Search prediction events on opensearch.predictionEventSignalIndex (dws_prediction_event_signal_hf alias, hourly UNIQUE part_hour+venue+venue_event_id). query/coin/category optional; coin-only unsupported_filter.

servers.name: Gate MCP - DEX / Web3 wallet
servers.setup: Remote URL https://api.gatemcp.ai/mcp/dex; calls need Google or Gate OAuth (listing is public)

tools.name: dex_agentic_report
tools.description: Register agentic wallet addresses with the wallet service.

tools.name: dex_auth_gate_login_poll
tools.description: Poll Gate OAuth; returns pending/ok/error. [write] On ok: replace mcp_token unless linked_to_google_session is true. Pass auto_replace_binding=true to rebind exchange UID on new Gate session.

tools.name: dex_auth_gate_login_start
tools.description: Start Gate device login. Show verification_uri and user_code to the user. Keep poll_secret for polling and do not show it. Pass link_mcp_token on a Google session to bind Gate UID without replacing mcp_token.

tools.name: dex_auth_google_login_poll
tools.description: Poll Google device login; returns pending/ok/error. Requires poll_secret from start. [write] On ok: immediately replace stored mcp_token with login_result.mcp_token — new token is tied to a different account.

tools.name: dex_auth_google_login_start
tools.description: Starts Google device login. Show verification_uri and user_code to the user. Keep poll_secret for dex_auth_google_login_poll and do not show it to the user.

tools.name: dex_auth_login_gate_wallet
tools.description: Exchange Gate OAuth code for MCP token. [write] On success, immediately replace any stored mcp_token — new token is tied to a different account.

tools.name: dex_auth_login_google_wallet
tools.description: Exchange Google OAuth code for MCP token. [write] On success, immediately replace any stored mcp_token — new token is tied to a different account.

tools.name: dex_auth_logout
tools.description: Revoke the MCP session identified by mcp_token.

tools.description: AMM pool deposit and withdrawal events. Candlesticks→get_kline. Volume stats→get_tx_stats.

tools.name: dex_market_get_tx_stats
tools.description: Per-interval buy/sell volume and tx counts (5m–24h). Candlesticks→get_kline. Pool events→get_pair_liquidity.

tools.description: Proxy a JSON-RPC call to a blockchain node.

tools.description: Receivable assets on target chain for a source token. Same-chain trading→list_swap_tokens.

tools.description: Tradable assets on a chain; tag selects favorites or recommendations. Bridge targets→list_cross_chain_bridge_tokens.

tools.name: dex_tx_approve_preview
tools.description: Build ERC20/SPL approve or revoke tx (does not broadcast). Sign with dex_wallet_sign_transaction after user confirmation.

tools.name: dex_tx_detail
tools.description: Fetch transaction detail by on-chain hash. → swap_detail for swap order detail by order ID.

tools.name: dex_tx_gas
tools.description: Estimate on-chain gas price and gas limit for a given tx.

tools.name: dex_tx_get_sol_unsigned
tools.description: Solana native only: build a fresh unsigned SOL transfer with a confirmed blockhash. Call only after the user confirms, then dex_wallet_sign_transaction and dex_tx_send_raw_transaction in the same turn.

tools.name: dex_tx_list
tools.description: List wallet transaction history (transfers). → swap_history_list for swap/bridge orders. → tx_detail for single tx by hash.

tools.name: dex_tx_send_raw_transaction
tools.description: Broadcast a signed tx to the chain. [write] Requires user confirmation after transfer preview and prior signing via dex_wallet_sign_transaction. Solana: pass last_valid_block_height from dex_tx_get_sol_unsigned.

tools.name: dex_tx_swap_checkin_preview
tools.description: Returns check-in fields for a swap stage (approve or swap). Call after prepare and before terminal tx-checkin script.

tools.name: dex_tx_swap_detail
tools.description: Fetch swap order detail by order ID from swap_submit. → tx_detail for detail by on-chain hash.

tools.name: dex_tx_swap_history_list
tools.description: List swap/bridge order history with pagination; includes single-chain and cross-chain. → tx_list for transfer history.

tools.name: dex_tx_swap_prepare
tools.description: Stage a swap session (server-side build only); returns swap_session_id. Does not sign or submit. Call after quote confirmed by user.

tools.name: dex_tx_swap_quote
tools.description: Returns swap route and pricing. Call before swap_prepare; show result to user before proceeding. → transfer_preview for direct token send (not exchange).

tools.name: dex_tx_swap_sign_approve
tools.description: [write] Sign the ERC20 approve tx for a staged EVM swap. Requires need_approved=true in prepare result.

tools.name: dex_tx_swap_sign_swap
tools.description: [write] Sign the main swap tx for a staged session. EVM: call sign_approve first if need_approved=true. Solana: generates a fresh signable payload.

tools.name: dex_tx_swap_submit
tools.description: [write] Broadcast a staged swap to the chain. Does not sign. Requires all signing steps complete (sign_approve if EVM+approval, then sign_swap).

tools.name: dex_tx_transfer_preview
tools.description: Build a transfer summary (sender, recipient, amount, gas). Does not broadcast. Solana native: returns key_info only — after the user confirms, call dex_tx_get_sol_unsigned and sign that result immediately.

tools.name: dex_tx_x402_checkin_preview
tools.description: Prepare Gate Verify tx_checkin for x402 (EVM exact / EIP-3009 only): returns tx_checkin.message (64-hex digest) and x402_payment_required_b64 without signing. Flow.

tools.name: dex_tx_x402_fetch
tools.description: [write] Send an HTTP request to the given URL. If the server responds with 402 Payment Required, pay via x402 (Coinbase-style: USDC EIP-3009 / Permit2 on EVM, SPL on Solana), retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. REQUIRED.

tools.name: dex_wallet_bind_exchange_uid
tools.description: Bind Gate exchange UID to session. Standalone Gate session only; gateUid must equal login_result.gate_uid from Gate OAuth. → replace_binding to rebind.

tools.name: dex_wallet_get_addresses
tools.description: Returns address map by chain type (EVM, SOL, etc.). Call before transfer/swap tools to get the sender address.

tools.name: dex_wallet_get_bindings
tools.description: Returns current Gate UID binding for the session wallet.

tools.name: dex_wallet_get_token_list
tools.description: Token balances and prices with pagination; filter by network_keys. → get_total_asset for portfolio summary only.

tools.name: dex_wallet_get_total_asset
tools.description: Total portfolio value and 24h change. → get_token_list for per-token balance detail.

tools.name: dex_wallet_get_wallet_type
tools.description: Returns walletAddress, walletType, gateUid. With for_withdraw_to_exchange or for_gate_oauth_bind, also starts Gate OAuth when gateUid is missing.

tools.name: dex_wallet_google_gate_bind_start
tools.description: Google sessions only: starts Gate OAuth to bind Gate exchange UID to this session. mcp_token stays unchanged after poll.

tools.name: dex_wallet_replace_binding
tools.description: Rebind Gate exchange UID. [write] newUid must equal login_result.gate_uid from a fresh Gate OAuth. Blocked for gate_mcp/gate_quick sessions and Google sessions.

tools.name: dex_wallet_sign_message
tools.description: Sign a 32-byte hex message with wallet key. [write] Requires checkin_token from terminal tx-checkin. → sign_transaction for raw tx signing.

tools.name: dex_wallet_sign_transaction
tools.description: Sign a raw unsigned transaction. [write] Requires user confirmation after transfer preview and checkin_token from terminal tx-checkin. → dex_tx_send_raw_transaction to broadcast.

tools.name: dex_withdraw_deposit_address
tools.description: Fetch Gate exchange deposit address for the session-bound Gate UID. [write] amount must be ≥ min_deposit_amount; do not pass uid — it is resolved from the session.

servers.name: CoinPaprika MCP
servers.setup: Remote URL https://mcp.coinpaprika.com/streamable-http (or /sse); free tier without a key, CoinPaprika API key for paid plans

tools.name: getCoins
tools.description: List all available coins with id, name, symbol and rank. Use to discover coins or map a name to an id. Does NOT include prices; for prices use getTickers or getTickersById. Read-only.

tools.name: getCoinById
tools.description: Get descriptive project information about a coin: description, links, team and tags. Use for 'tell me about Uniswap', 'what is this project'. Does NOT include price; for price and market cap use getTickersById.

tools.name: getCoinEvents
tools.description: Get the timeline of events for a coin (launches, partnerships, hard forks, conference talks) with dates and descriptions. Use for 'what is happening with X', 'upcoming events for Ethereum', 'X roadmap events'.

tools.name: getCoinExchanges
tools.description: List the exchanges that LIST a specific coin (venue names only). Use for 'which exchanges list X', 'is X on Coinbase', 'where is X listed'. For where to BUY with per-market price and volume use getCoinMarkets.

tools.name: getCoinMarkets
tools.description: Get the specific markets and trading pairs where a coin trades, with per-market price and 24h volume. Use for 'where can I buy X', 'X price on Binance', 'best market for X'.

tools.name: getCoinOHLCVLatest
tools.description: Get the latest full-day OHLC candle (open, high, low, close and volume) for a coin. Use for 'yesterday's candle for BTC'. For the live spot price use getTickersById. Read-only.

tools.name: getCoinOHLCVToday
tools.description: Get today's in-progress OHLC candle for a coin. Use for 'today's high and low for ETH'. For the current spot price use getTickersById; for yesterday's full candle use getCoinOHLCVLatest.

tools.name: getTickers
tools.description: Get current prices, market caps and 24h changes for the top cryptocurrencies ranked by market cap. Use for 'top 5 coins', 'top crypto today', 'biggest cryptocurrencies', or a market snapshot.

tools.name: getTickersById
tools.description: Get the current price, market cap, 24h change and volume of one cryptocurrency in USD or another quote currency. Use for 'what is the price of X', 'how much is Bitcoin worth', 'BTC to USD', 'ETH price now'.

tools.name: getTickersHistoricalById
tools.description: Get a coin's price, market cap and volume at past times as point-in-time snapshots (not OHLC candles). Use for 'price of BTC last Tuesday', 'ETH market cap on 2024-01-01'.

tools.name: getExchanges
tools.description: List exchanges tracked by CoinPaprika as a list ranked by rank, each with id, name, trust score, active market count and 24h volume. Use for 'top exchanges by volume', 'biggest crypto exchanges'.

tools.name: getExchangeByID
tools.description: Get details for a specific exchange: 24h volume, market count, trust score, links and fiat support. Use for 'tell me about Binance', 'Coinbase exchange stats', 'is X a trustworthy exchange'.

tools.name: getExchangeMarkets
tools.description: List the trading pairs (markets) on one exchange as a list, each with the pair, base and quote coin ids, latest price, 24h volume and category. Use for 'what pairs trade on Binance', 'markets on Kraken'.

tools.name: getPeopleById
tools.description: Get the profile of one person in crypto by id: name, description or bio, teams_count, positions held, and linked projects plus social and code accounts. Use for 'who is Vitalik Buterin', 'background on Charlie Lee'.

tools.name: getTags
tools.description: List all CoinPaprika tags (categories such as 'defi', 'stablecoin', 'memecoin', 'ai') used to group coins, returned as a list with each tag's id, name, coin_counter and ico_counter. Use for 'what crypto categories exist'

tools.name: getTagById
tools.description: Get details for one CoinPaprika tag (a category such as 'defi' or 'stablecoin'): its id, name, description, coin_counter, ico_counter, and optionally the coins and ICOs grouped under it.

tools.name: getPlatforms
tools.description: List the smart-contract platforms (blockchains such as ethereum, bnb, polygon) for which CoinPaprika indexes token contracts. Use for 'which chains are supported for contract lookups', 'list contract platforms'.

tools.name: getContracts
tools.description: List the token contract addresses tracked on one platform as a list, mapping each contract to its CoinPaprika coin id. Use for 'contracts on ethereum', 'what tokens does BSC have'.

tools.name: getTickerByContract
tools.description: Get the current price and market data of a token by its contract address (for on-chain and DeFi tokens). Use when you have a contract address (0x...) rather than a name. For history use getHistoricalTickerByContract.

tools.name: getHistoricalTickerByContract
tools.description: Get a token's price and market history by its contract address, as a time series. Use for 'token price on 2024-01-01 by address', 'hourly history for a contract'. For its current price use getTickerByContract.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Get the CoinPaprika MCP server's status and configuration (uptime, mode, enabled features). Use when asked 'is the server up', 'what mode am I in', 'server status'. This reports the MCP server itself.

tools.name: getGlobal
tools.description: Get a global crypto market overview: total market cap, total 24h volume, Bitcoin dominance, and market-wide 24h change. Use for 'how is the crypto market doing', 'total market cap', 'BTC dominance'.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Broadly search CoinPaprika across coins, exchanges, ICOs, people and tags by name or symbol when the entity type is unknown or you are exploring. Use for 'find anything called X'.

tools.name: resolveId
tools.description: Resolve a fuzzy coin, exchange, person or tag name or symbol to a ranked list of candidate CoinPaprika ids, best first (take the top one). Call FIRST when you have a bare name or symbol but need an id.

tools.name: priceConverter
tools.description: Convert an amount from one crypto or fiat to another at the current rate, e.g. 'how much is 0.5 BTC in USD', 'convert 100 USDC to EUR'. For a plain coin price without an amount, use getTickersById. Read-only.

tools.name: getCapabilities
tools.description: Get the server's capabilities, supported workflow patterns, validation rules and recommended tool sequences. Use FIRST to onboard as an agent, or when asked 'what can this server do', 'how should I chain these tools'.

tools.name: submitFeedback
tools.description: Report a problem or gap back to the CoinPaprika MCP maintainers: call it when you got stuck, a response was unexpected, information you needed was missing, or a tool did not behave as documented. Use when the user says '

servers.notes: Official CoinPaprika server (~31 stars; registry com.coinpaprika/coinpaprika). 27 tools read from the live public tools/list: coins, events, markets, OHLCV, tickers incl. historical, exchanges and their markets, people, tags, platforms/contracts with contract-address pricing, global market, search, ID resolution, price conversion, capabilities, feedback.

servers.source_url: https://mcp.dexpaprika.com/streamable-http (public tools/list, no key); source github.com/coinpaprika/dexpaprika-mcp src/index.js
servers.setup: Remote URL https://mcp.dexpaprika.com/streamable-http, or npx dexpaprika-mcp locally; no API key

tools.name: getNetworks
tools.description: List every blockchain network DexPaprika indexes, each row carrying its network id (slug), 24h volume, transaction count, and pool count. Read-only and keyless.

tools.name: getNetworkDexes
tools.description: List the DEXes (exchanges) operating on one network, such as Uniswap on ethereum or Raydium on solana, returned under 'dexes' with page_info (page, total_pages). Read-only and keyless.

tools.name: getNetworkPools
tools.description: Get the top liquidity pools across a whole network, ranked by 24h volume by default, returned under 'results' with has_next_page and next_cursor. Read-only and keyless. This is the primary chain-wide pool discovery tool.

tools.name: getDexPools
tools.description: Get the pools belonging to one specific DEX on one network, e.g. all Uniswap v3 pools on ethereum, returned under 'results' with has_next_page and next_cursor. Read-only and keyless.

tools.name: getNetworkPoolsFilter
tools.description: Get pools on one network filtered by numeric thresholds, returned under 'results' with has_next_page and next_cursor. Read-only and keyless.

tools.name: getPoolDetails
tools.description: Get the full current snapshot for one pool by address: its two tokens, current price, liquidity/TVL, 24h volume, and transaction counts, returned as a single pool object (not a list). Read-only and keyless.

tools.name: getPoolOHLCV
tools.description: Get historical OHLCV candles (open, high, low, close, volume) for one pool over a time range, returned as a time-series array. Read-only and keyless. Use for 'price history of this pair', 'hourly chart for the last week'

tools.name: getPoolIndicator
tools.description: Get a technical indicator (RSI, EMA, MACD, Bollinger Bands or VWAP) for one pool, computed server-side from the pool's completed OHLCV candles and returned as a time series. Read-only and keyless.

tools.name: getPoolTransactions
tools.description: Get one pool's recent individual swap transactions, newest first, returned under 'transactions' (paginate with page, or a cursor). Read-only. Runs on the caller's own Dev, Pro or Enterprise API key.

tools.name: getTokenDetails
tools.description: Get one token's data and metadata by contract address on one network: multi-timeframe price and volume metrics, plus name, website, Twitter, and Telegram links, returned as a single token object. Read-only and keyless.

tools.name: getTokenPools
tools.description: Get the liquidity pools that contain a specific token on one network, returned under 'results' with has_next_page and next_cursor. Read-only and keyless.

tools.name: getTopTokens
tools.description: Get the top tokens on one network ranked by volume, liquidity, transactions, FDV, or 24h price change, returned under 'results' with has_next_page and next_cursor. Read-only and keyless.

tools.name: filterNetworkTokens
tools.description: Get tokens on one network matching numeric thresholds, returned under 'results' with has_next_page and next_cursor. Read-only and keyless.

tools.name: getTokenMultiPrices
tools.description: Get current USD prices for up to 10 tokens on the same network in one batched call, returned as a prices array plus a missing_tokens list. Read-only and keyless.

tools.name: getTokenOHLCV
tools.description: Get historical USD OHLCV candles for one token over a time range, returned as a time-series array. The price and volume are computed across every pool the token trades in on the network.

tools.name: getTokenIndicator
tools.description: Get a technical indicator (RSI, EMA, MACD, Bollinger Bands or VWAP) for one token, computed server-side from the token's USD candles across every pool it trades in on the network (the same series as getTokenOHLCV)

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search across ALL networks at once for tokens, pools, and DEXes by name, symbol, or address, returning three arrays: 'tokens', 'pools', and 'dexes'. Read-only and keyless.

tools.name: getStats
tools.description: Get platform-wide totals for DexPaprika: the number of networks, DEXes, pools, and tokens indexed, returned as a single summary object. Read-only and keyless. Use for 'how much data do you cover?'.

tools.name: getCapabilities
tools.description: Get the static agent onboarding guide for this server: supported workflows, network name synonyms (mapping words like 'eth' to the canonical slug 'ethereum'), recommended call sequences, and common pitfalls.

tools.name: submitFeedback
tools.description: Report a problem back to the DexPaprika team when a tool got you stuck, returned something unexpected, lacked data you needed, or behaved differently than documented. Use whenever you hit a dead end.

servers.notes: Official DexPaprika server (~119 stars). 20 tools from the live public tools/list: DEX networks, DEXes, pools (top, filtered, details, OHLCV, transactions), tokens (details, pools, top, filtered, batch prices, OHLCV), server-side indicators (RSI, EMA, MACD, Bollinger, VWAP), cross-network search, stats.

tools.name: get_native_balance
tools.description: Get the native coin (e.g. ETH) balance of an address, in wei.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Get the list of normal (external) transactions for an address.

tools.name: get_internal_transactions
tools.description: Get internal transactions for an address, or by a specific parent transaction hash.

tools.name: get_token_transfers
tools.description: Get token transfer events for an address, optionally filtered by token contract. Select the token standard: erc20 (fungible, default), erc721 (NFT), or erc1155 (multi-token).

tools.name: resolve_ens_name
tools.description: Resolve an ENS name (or onchain subdomain, e.g. etherscan.eth or gm.etherscan.eth) to its Ethereum address. Ethereum mainnet only. Offchain names that require CCIP Read / wildcard resolution.

tools.name: get_contract_source
tools.description: Get the verified source code and metadata for a contract address.

tools.name: get_contract_abi
tools.description: Get the verified ABI (JSON) for a contract address.

tools.name: get_contract_creation
tools.description: Get the creator address and creation transaction hash for up to 5 contract addresses. The multi-kilobyte creation bytecode is omitted by default to keep responses small; set include_creation_bytecode=true to include it.

tools.name: get_transaction_receipt_status
tools.description: Get the receipt status of a transaction (1 = success, 0 = failed). Post-Byzantium only.

tools.name: get_transaction_status
tools.description: Get the contract execution status of a transaction (detects failed/erroring executions).

tools.name: get_gas_oracle
tools.description: Get current gas price recommendations (safe / propose / fast) from the gas tracker.

tools.name: get_block_by_timestamp
tools.description: Get the block number closest to a given Unix timestamp (seconds).

tools.name: get_supported_chains
tools.description: Get the chains / chain IDs supported by the Etherscan V2 API. In the hosted (proxy) deployment this returns a bundled snapshot shipped with the server, refreshed when the package is updated.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Search event logs by contract address and/or topics over a block range. Topics are 32-byte hex values; topic0 is usually the keccak256 event-signature hash.

tools.name: get_transaction_by_hash
tools.description: Get the full transaction object for a transaction hash (from, to, value, input data, gas, gas price, nonce, block number/hash, transaction index). Returns null if the hash is unknown.

tools.name: get_transaction_receipt
tools.description: Get the transaction receipt for a transaction hash (execution status, gas used, cumulative gas used, effective gas price, logs, and the created contract address for deployments)

tools.name: render_etherscan_widget
tools.description: Present exact facts returned by Etherscan data tools in a fast explorer-style card. Call the relevant Etherscan data tool first and copy only supported values into this tool. Never invent scores, risk labels.

servers.notes: Onchain explorer data across Etherscan-supported chains: balances, transactions and receipts, token transfers, internal transactions, logs, contract ABI/source/creation, gas oracle, ENS, block by timestamp, widget rendering. 17 tools; live public list and Claude directory list match exactly.

servers.source_url: https://mcp.blockscout.com/mcp (public tools/list, no key; server v1.26.0); source repo github.com/blockscout/mcp-server

tools.name: __unlock_blockchain_analysis__
tools.description: Initializes a Blockscout MCP session: returns server reference data, the `blockscout-analysis` skill pointer, and the URI resolution rule. Call this tool exactly once per session, before any other tool.

tools.name: get_block_info
tools.description: Get block information like timestamp, gas used, burnt fees, transaction count etc. Can optionally include the list of transaction hashes contained in the block. Transaction hashes are omitted by default.

tools.name: get_block_number
tools.description: Retrieves the block number and timestamp for a specific date/time or the latest block. Use when you need a block height for a specific point in time (e.g., "block at 2024-01-01") or the current chain tip.

tools.name: get_address_by_ens_name
tools.description: Useful for when you need to convert an ENS domain name (e.g. "blockscout.eth") to its corresponding Ethereum address.

tools.name: get_transactions_by_address
tools.description: Retrieves native currency transfers and smart contract interactions (calls, internal txs) for an address. **EXCLUDES TOKEN TRANSFERS**: Filters out direct token balance changes (ERC-20, etc.)

tools.name: get_token_transfers_by_address
tools.description: Get ERC-20 token transfers for an address within a specific time range. **SUPPORTS PAGINATION**: If response includes 'pagination' field, use the provided next_call to get additional pages.

tools.name: lookup_token_by_symbol
tools.description: Search for token addresses by symbol or name. Returns multiple potential matches based on symbol or token name similarity. Only the first 7 matches from the Blockscout API are returned.

tools.name: get_contract_abi
tools.description: Get smart contract ABI (Application Binary Interface). An ABI defines all functions, events, their parameters, and return types. The ABI is required to format function calls or interpret contract data.

tools.name: inspect_contract_code
tools.description: Inspects a verified contract's source code or metadata.

tools.name: read_contract
tools.description: Calls a smart contract function (view/pure, or non-view/pure simulated via eth_call) and returns the decoded result.

tools.name: get_address_info
tools.description: Get comprehensive information about an address, including: - Address existence check - Native token (ETH) balance (provided as is, without adjusting by decimals)

tools.name: get_tokens_by_address
tools.description: Get comprehensive ERC20 token holdings for an address with enriched metadata and market data. Returns detailed token information including contract details (name, symbol, decimals), market metrics.

tools.name: nft_tokens_by_address
tools.description: Retrieve NFT tokens (ERC-721, ERC-404, ERC-1155) owned by an address, grouped by collection. Provides collection details (type, address, name, symbol, total supply, holder count) and individual token instance data.

tools.name: get_transaction_info
tools.description: Get comprehensive transaction information. Unlike standard eth_getTransactionByHash, this tool returns enriched data including decoded input parameters, detailed token transfers with token metadata.

tools.name: get_chains_list
tools.description: Get supported blockchain chains with their chain IDs.

tools.name: direct_api_call
tools.description: Call a raw Blockscout API endpoint for advanced or chain-specific data.

servers.notes: Multichain explorer data (balances, tokens, NFTs, transactions, transfers, blocks, logs, contract code/ABI/read calls, direct API passthrough). 16 tools read from the live public tools/list; the Claude directory shows an older 15-tool list (has get_latest_block, get_transaction_logs, transaction_summary instead of get_block_number, inspect_contract_code, lookup_token_by_symbol, direct_api_call). ~46 GitHub stars.

servers.notes: ~1,060 stars, pushed 2026-10-18. Broad OSINT server, finance is one slice: 160 Tool() definitions in 20 domain modules (count matches README): markets, crypto, FX, yields, commodities, liquidity (FRED/ECB), SEC filings, earnings, Kalshi/Polymarket, plus conflict, military flights, hazards, migration, cyber and news.
